recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source work is recommended for FHIR-12365 unless the work group later standardizes a more precise MLLP URI scheme; such a future decision should update Endpoint examples consistently.
issue_request: FHIR-12365 was a Published Patient Administration change request asking how to represent Endpoint.address for a v2 MLLP connection. Its persuasive-with-modification resolution required documenting an address that includes the TCP listener address and port.
initial_application: Commit 05f9cb8d10 applied the issue by changing the built Endpoint general examples CSV v2 referral row from a bare IP address to mllp://127.0.0.1:4001 and changing the MIME type to x-application/hl7-v2+er7. The current source still contains that row and the template renders it into the narrative and Endpoint.address.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. Endpoint.address is a url whose comment permits message endpoints in server-understood URL forms, usually http: or mllp:. A 2018 Zulip committers thread records that GF#12365 was tagged for R5 and that the address format was clear enough to handle in an example. Later FHIR-39617 added a separate AU HL7v2 MLLP Endpoint example, but that is separate Endpoint example work and does not alter the seed decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Endpoint examples already demonstrate the requested v2 MLLP address with scheme, IP address, colon, and port, and the Endpoint.address definition is compatible with that MLLP URL form.

related_jiras.note: A later commit added a separate AU HL7v2 MLLP Endpoint example with profileUri coverage; it reinforces the same artifact family but was not needed to decide FHIR-12365.
